_doc: Split recipe for agents/silent-failure-hunter.md (dormant repo agent, never installed). Capability inventory: Read, Grep, Glob RETAINED via the investigator carrier; Bash REMOVED (the role is static review; Grep covers its searches and no hunt target needs a command). Prompt Defense Baseline moved to the shared primitive, byte-identical. Output format RETAINED in the page; the proof-bundle contract wraps each finding as a claim.

contract.name: Silent failure and swallowed error reviewer
contract.sovereign_question: Where does this code fail without anyone finding out?
contract.retirement_condition: a static analyzer rule set reproduces its findings on a held-out sample

agent.description: Reviews code for silent failures, swallowed errors, bad fallbacks and missing error propagation.
